name: Gibara
text: Gibara (Spanish pronunciation: [xiˈβaɾa]) is a town and municipality of the Province of Holguín in the Republic of Cuba. Gibara is the fourth largest town by population and the ninth by area in Holguín.

depictions.name: Gibara
depictions.text: Gibara was one of the forts in the West Indies during the early 18th century that protected important trade routes. Like many of the forts in the West Indies, it was under the control of the Spanish Navy. The fort was located on a small island just south of Salt Lagoon and northwest of Crooked Island.
